title: "Import TCGA and GDC Data"
lastupdated: "08-31-2026"
---

```{r Libraries, include = FALSE}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
```


## Setup
```{r Set Cancer Type}
dataset <- "LIHC"
```


## Clinical Metadata
Extracting the important clinical data for each patient (age, gender, alcohol, smoking).
```{r Importing Clinical Data}
clinical_metadata <- GDCquery_clinic(paste0("TCGA-",dataset))
```

```{r Importing Metadata from Sequencing Data}
query_sequencing = GDCquery(
  project = paste0("TCGA-",dataset),
  data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
  experimental.strategy = "RNA-Seq",
  workflow.type = "STAR - Counts",
  data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification",
  access = "open",
  sample.type = "Primary Tumor"
)

sequencing_metadata <- getResults(query_sequencing)
sequencing_metadata <- unique(sequencing_metadata, by = "cases.submitter_id")
```

``` {r Combined Clinical Metadata}
combined_metadata <- merge(clinical_metadata, sequencing_metadata,
                       by.x = 'submitter_id',
                       by.y = 'cases.submitter_id'
)

combined_metadata <- select(combined_metadata, where(~ !is.list(.)))
```


## Bulk RNA Seq Counts
Importing the bulk RNA sequencing counts matrix.
```{r Importing Counts Matrix}
query_counts <- GDCquery(
  project = paste0("TCGA-", dataset),
  data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
  experimental.strategy = "RNA-Seq",
  workflow.type = "STAR - Counts",
  data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification",
  access = "open",
  barcode = combined_metadata$cases,
)

# Downloading data from GDC (Will take a while)
GDCdownload(query_counts)

tcga_data <- GDCprepare(query_counts)

# ENSEMBL gene and tumor sample metadata
gene_metadata <- as.data.frame(rowData(tcga_data))
```

```{r Normalizing Counts Matrix}
counts_matrix <- assay(tcga_data, "unstranded")

col_data <- as.data.frame(colData(tcga_data))
col_data <- subset(col_data, select = -c(treatments, primary_site, disease_type))

deseq_dataset <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_matrix,
                                        colData = col_data,
                                        design = ~ 1)

# removing the genes with less than 10 reads across all samples 
deseq_dataset <- deseq_dataset[rowSums(counts(deseq_dataset)) >= 10, ]

# variance stabilizing transformation to normalize count data 
vst_counts_matrix <- as.data.frame(assay(vst(deseq_dataset, blind = FALSE)))
```


## Output CSV Data Files
```{r Outputs}
write.csv(vst_counts_matrix, paste0(dataset, "_counts.csv"))
write.csv(gene_metadata, paste0(dataset, "_gene_metadata.csv"))
write.csv(combined_metadata, paste0(dataset, "_clinical.csv"))
```
